items.summary: Resting-state and structural MRI from 45 adults with Parkinson disease and 30 matched controls, scanned at one centre in the Netherlands between 2018 and 2021.

items.summary: This dataset contains twelve hours of continuous twelve lead electrocardiogram recordings gathered from twenty hospitalised patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation on a cardiology ward, and it also includes the complete set of expert annotation files used in the original published study.
